_comment: Saved reports that are junk left on the stand, hidden from the report tools.
Nothing here changes the Back Office. Reports are not deleted; this file only
decides what the MCP server surfaces.
This list is deliberately narrow. The Back Office already restricts reports per
user - a non-administrator sees fewer of them in GET /reports - so there is no
need to reproduce that here. What the BO cannot know is which reports are dated
snapshots, (copy) duplicates, superseded versions or somebody's test, and those
are noise for everyone. Only those are listed.
Hidden reports disappear from bo_search_reports, bo_explain_report refuses them,
and bo_request blocks GET /reports/{id} before the request leaves the machine.
Set TR_BO_SHOW_ALL_REPORTS=true to see them anyway, for maintenance.
To restore a report, delete its entry. To hide a new one, add it with a reason.
